items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Because I had already known Ben... I had been corresponding with him for years, though, before I came to California. ... I met Blanton the same time I met Ben.

ctx.x: Yeah, '38, '39... [RAY NANCE JOINED DUKE IN NOV. '40] Because I had already known Ben... I had been corresponding with him for years, though, before I came to California.
